title: Add an internal CodeMirror lesson editor exemplar
summary: Bounded economics editor exemplar implemented and verified; promotion to shared lesson-authoring infrastructure remains a human visual and workflow decision.

progress.summary: Economics now has one internal CodeMirror passage editor exemplar with local draft persistence, add/duplicate/move/delete/reset actions, semantic ID completion, live KaTeX preview, and last-valid fallback. Editor shell, draft runtime, preview compiler, KaTeX, CSS, and CodeMirror load only after Edit is requested; the learner route remains within its existing production budgets at 249885 transfer bytes, 149998 script bytes, 42 resources, and zero CLS.
